items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: And Buckingham's one that sit there for hours.

ctx.x: Did you ever see any white dance band? Oh, yeah. In those days.

Oh, yeah. They did that? Yeah, yeah. String band, two, six pieces. Yeah, I saw plenty of them. We had them. During the time, I picked up here there, the young bunch around there, I mean they could play. I forget all the names now. One of them, daddy had a Jewish stuff. They all did now. We used to get in those, you know, used to have those furniture wagons. We used to get in there. We used to hook together, you know, tailgate. Yeah. You know about the bruners? Yeah, the bruners. Well, there's one over here. Well,…
I like the color. That's right.
